data.long_meaning: Derived from Juno, the Roman goddess of marriage and childbirth. The name Junette is a diminutive form of Juno, expressing a sense of love, protection, and nurturing. The name Junette carries the meaning “Juno's little one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Junette usually hope their child will grow to embody juno's little one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
